method: Archived files parsed as PDFs; SHA-256 hashes checked against 15 official remote documents and one pre-existing supplied file. Statutory summaries are curated paraphrases; primary_checked verifies the identified passages, not exhaustive current-law completeness. See docs/SOURCE_UPDATES.md.

documents.title: The Patents Act, 1970
documents.scope: Sections 2(1)(j)/(ja)/(l), 3(c)/(d)/(e)/(i)/(j)/(p), 9, 10, 11A, 25, 29-34, 48, 64, 73-74; eligibility/disclosure provisions, not a current patent search or complete amendment review. Additional passage review on 28 September 2026: ss.6,7(2)-(3),10(6),28(1),68,69(1)-(3), PDF/printed pp.10-11,13,22-23,37; inventorship, entitlement and patent transactions, not a case-specific ownership decision.
documents.verification: Archive SHA-256 matches PDF retrieved through the signed English-PDF link on the WIPO Lex landing page on 27 September 2026. Bare resource URLs redirect to HTML; use the landing-page PDF link. Expiring signed URLs are not stored.

documents.title: CDSCO: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and Rules, 1945, compilation amended through 31 December 2016
documents.scope: Act sections 3(a), 3(h)(i), 33EEC (pages 6, 8, 28-29); rules 152-155B, 157-158B, 160-161 (pages 177-190), Schedule T/TA. Dated official compilation; current amendments, fees and State workflows require separate confirmation. Additional passage review on 28 September 2026: ss.3(aaa),3(a),3(b)(i), PDF/printed pp.6-7; cosmetic-purpose/drug-category boundary, not a product classification or licence exemption.
documents.verification: Remote PDF and archive SHA-256 match.

documents.title: WIPO overview of national and regional trade-secret systems: India, June 2024
documents.scope: Pages 1-2, sections 1-3 and 5. Official intergovernmental overview, not Indian legislation or a judgment. Not evidence of absence of later trade-secret legislation; unused criminal-law and restrictive-covenant summaries have not been adopted.
documents.verification: Remote PDF and archive SHA-256 match.

documents.title: Supplied CDSCO Drugs Rules compilation amended through 1 July 2024
documents.scope: Cross-check of rules 152-158B, 160-161 and Schedule T/TA; rule 158B tables at pages 178-181 and labelling pages 190-191. This supplement does not replace the verified 2016 remote primary source. Exact original download URL is not established.
documents.verification: Valid 963-page PDF; SHA-256 equals the pre-existing supplied parent-directory file. Publisher identity is stated by the document. Remote byte-match was not independently established.

documents.title: Cosmetics Rules, 2020 - G.S.R. 763(E), 15 December 2020
documents.scope: Base Gazette only: rr.3(p),(r),(u),4(2),23,25; English PDF/printed pp.73-75,80-81. Manufacture/loan-licence route and specific new-cosmetic caveat. Does not assert current fees, State workflow or complete amendments as of 2026.
documents.verification: Retrieved through the official CDSCO listing and its download wrapper; actual iframe PDF archived, not the wrapper HTML. Valid 136-page Gazette, rendered relevant pages and checked text/footnotes. No exhaustive later-amendment search.

supplementary_review_note: Four records added on 28 September 2026 from two existing archives and one newly archived official Gazette; see docs/SOURCE_COVERAGE_REPAIR.md. Earlier verification metadata remains unchanged.
